messages:
maria (Partnerships): Quick sync — press sprint + SI standby choreography for our CloudCatalog listing tomorrow. Need final checks on: 1) embargo time, 2) landing page CTA + tenant onboarding link, 3) SI on-call roster & runbook, 4) hardware partner asset delivery. Looping in folks who own each area.

kai (PMM): Landing page is staged: https://staging.redwood.com/catalog?preview=1 — CTA copy currently 'Try Redwood Inference on CloudCatalog' (legal to confirm). Blog draft is ready, just need hero asset and final headline.

thomas (PR): Proposed embargo: 09:00 PT on 2026-03-30. If that works we need final customer quotes by EOD today. Planning a 08:15 PT embargo check call (30m) — who can join?

liz (Legal): Can greenlight the CTA but we should swap the one instance of 'CloudCatalog' to 'Marketplace' per trademark check. I'll post a quick redline in this thread.

juan (Partner Eng): SI on-call plan: @sarah first responder, then me as backup; @thomas for comms. Runbook is staged here: https://intranet/redwood/workflows/si-runbook (will export final). I'll also confirm partner artifacts landed.

sarah (Solutions Eng): Standby window confirmed — I'll be on 7:30–11:30 PT tomorrow. Please ping #release-war-room or DM if urgent.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy scheduled 02:00 UTC 2026-03-30. Please run the preflight checklist before that deploy.

maria (Partnerships): NimbusEdge (hardware partner) deliverables: hero image, benchmark CSV, and logo svg by 5pm PT today. @juan can you confirm S3 upload when they send?

juan (Partner Eng): Confirmed: s3://partners/nimbus/515555 contains hero_v3.png and nimbus_bench_2026.csv. I'll add presigned links in the doc in 5m.

kai (PMM): Blog draft location: https://docs.redwood/blogs/cloudcatalog-draft.md. We still need a short customer quote for the hero — @thomas do we have a Nimbus contact for a quote?

thomas (PR): Nimbus PR is looped in (cc: nimbus-press). I just asked for a one-sentence quote. If we don't get one, we'll use an anonymized enterprise metric and attribute to 'an early customer'.

maria (Partnerships): Action items — please ack: 1) Kai finalize CTA + hero asset (today 5pm PT). 2) Liz post legal redline for CTA (EOD). 3) Thomas secure quote + coordinate embargo (ASAP). 4) Juan export SI runbook + confirm S3 assets (done). 5) Sarah standby coverage tomorrow (7:30–11:30 PT). Reply 'ack' when you have it.

kai (PMM): ack

liz (Legal): ack — posting redline now, will attach language suggestions.

thomas (PR): ack — pinged Nimbus PR just now.

sarah (Solutions Eng): ack

maria (Partnerships): Thanks — I'll schedule the 08:15 PT embargo call if everyone acks. Quick note on press distro: US + UK tech press + partner lists included in the doc. Doc link: https://docs.redwood/announce/cadence-515555

thomas (PR): Added UK outlets. Also proposing a 30-min dry run at 16:00 PT today to walk through who says what. Who can make it?

kai (PMM): I can do 16:00 PT.

juan (Partner Eng): I can join 16:00 PT for SI checklist walkthrough.

sarah (Solutions Eng): I'll be on the 16:00 PT dry run.

maria (Partnerships): Great. Last check: any blockers on localization or region-specific legal for the press/landing? @liz

liz (Legal): No blockers for US/UK. For APAC we need a short review if we call out data residency or region-specific claims — recommend we postpone APAC messaging until GA to avoid delays.

maria (Partnerships): Noted — hold APAC copy for GA. I'm locking the doc and will send calendar invites for the dry run and embargo call. :tada:

(End thread)
